provenance.note: Generic layout from the standard Vacuum service (siid 2: status at piid 1, start-sweep aiid 1, stop-sweeping aiid 2) and the standard Battery service that in practice follows it (siid 3: battery-level at piid 1, start-charge aiid 1). Power is action-backed: turn_on starts a sweep, turn_off stops and docks. The onoff capability carries no property mapping because the device has no power property to map. Status codes are defined per model in each model's own instance value-list, so the driver reports the raw code unlabelled. Suction/mode layouts and extra actions (start-mop, room sweep; pause exists only as a model-specific extra on some brands) vary by model and are not claimed here.

source: MIoT-Spec standard Vacuum service definition (urn:miot-spec-v2:service:vacuum:00007810) and standard Battery service definition (urn:miot-spec-v2:service:battery:00007805), as published in the MIoT specification (miot-spec.org); the service order (vacuum siid 2, battery siid 3) matches published model instances (Roborock, Dreame, Viomi).
